concepts.def: Forward and reverse reactions proceed at equal rates in a closed system; macroscopic properties are constant.
When a system at equilibrium is disturbed, it shifts to partially counteract the change.
Ratio of product to reactant concentrations each raised to their stoichiometric coefficients at equilibrium.
Equivalent to Kc but uses partial pressures, used for gas-phase equilibria.
K changes with T; for an exothermic forward reaction, K decreases as T rises.
A catalyst speeds up both forward and reverse reactions equally; K is unchanged.
